title: Trajectories of national identity and civic-mindedness in research projects of humanities students
abstract: Importance. In the context of transforming socio-political landscapes, the role of higher education as a space for constructing civic identity is becoming increasingly important. Research projects by humanities students represent significant material for studying how abstract categories of nation and civic-mindedness are comprehended and experienced in practice. However, there is a lack of a holistic methodology for their examination in the literature. The purpose of the study is to identify and analyze the key vectors of civic-mindedness that emerge in humanities students’ research projects based on empirical material. Materials and Methods. The study is based on a qualitative analysis of 15 texts of student project concepts completed within the framework of the “Scientific Code” program. The methodological tool is the author’s model of “civic-mindedness mapping”, which involves analysis along the axes of “value focus” and “modality of research action”, as well as the parameter of “scale of responsibility”. title: The moral and ethical crisis of the service principles in the railway law enforcement agencies of Soviet Russia (1917–1922)
abstract: Importance of this study is driven by the need to understand governance practices during the collapse of the state apparatus and the Civil War – a period when the traditional triad of “Orthodoxy, Autocracy, Nationality” was outlawed and a new value system had yet to emerge. Drawing on archival documents, this paper aims to identify the specific nature and consequences of the crisis triggered by the discrediting of the religious component as the worldview foundation of state service. The hypothesis is that the undermining of faith deprived the authorities of their value-based and meaning-giving foundation, engendering a legitimacy crisis that the measures subsequently adopted failed to remedy. Materials and Methods. The historical-genetic method allows us to trace the transformation of the moral foundations of state service. The historical-systemic method is employed to analyse the operations of transport-sector agencies. Using the historical-comparative method and materials from the State Archive of the Russian Federation, the study compares disciplinary problems with the mechanisms of legitimization of power. title: Regulating the use of generative artificial intelligence by students when writing research papers on foreign language teaching methods
abstract: Importance . The widespread use of artificial intelligence (AI) plagiarism in the academic environment and the lack of federal regulatory legal acts establishing the scope and degree of legal use by undergraduate, graduate and post-graduate students of feedback materials from generative artificial intelligence tools in research determine the urgent need for universities to develop appropriate regulations. Considering the specifics of each individual field of study or specialty, such regulations should include two main components: a) universal, i.e. invariant for students regardless of research field; b) highly specialized, reflecting the specifics of a particular field of study or specialty. The purpose of this study is to develop a list of research tasks solved by students and graduate students in foreign language teaching methods field, and to illustrate the solution of these tasks with examples of feedback from generative AI. Materials and Methods . The research is based on the analysis of scientific literature dealing with the issues of teaching a foreign language based on technological solutions based on artificial intelligence, the problem of determining the didactic and ling

title: Typology of international legal disputes in the content and language integrated learning of law students
abstract: Importance . In modern conditions, it is possible to observe the objective need for a systematic study of legal disputes in the process of professional training of lawyers, since it is legal disputes that form the substantive core of legal activity. The formation of legal thinking takes place mainly through the analysis of conflict-of-laws relations, where the legal positions of the parties collide, argumentation mechanisms are implemented and a balance of interests is sought. Haphazard and fragmentary consideration of individual disputes does not allow students to form a holistic view of the international legal picture of the world, which makes it necessary to develop a scientifically based typology of legal disputes adapted to the tasks of legal education. Materials and Methods represent an interdisciplinary synthesis carried out at the junction of legal science, pedagogy and logic. The legal aspect of the research is implemented through formal legal and comparative legal analysis of international disputes. The pedagogical aspect includes modeling the educational process and analyzing the professional competencies of future international lawyers. The logical aspect is represented

title: Local air defense of Yaroslavl region during the Great Patriotic War (July 1943 – May 1945)
abstract: Introduction. The Great Patriotic War remains one of the relevant topics in modern historiography. At the same time, the system of local air defense (MPVO) remains understudied to this day. An analysis of the historiography reveals that there is a particular gap in research, especially considering the regional (Yaroslavl) specifics, concerning the period from July 1943. In this regard, the aim of the research is a comprehensive analysis of the activities of the local air defense in Yaroslavl region from July 1943 to May 1945. Materials and Methods. The research is based on the analysis of archival documents from the State Archive of Yaroslavl Region and the Center for Documentation of Contemporary History, as well as scientific publications. The historical-systemic and comparative-historical methods were employed. Results and Discussion. The analysis revealed that in 1943–1945, plans for the construction and repair of shelters, provision of collective protection means to the population, and implementation of technical measures were not fully implemented. title: The Polish state in the British political elite strategy (1919–1920)
abstract: Importance. During periods of painful transformation of interstate relations systems, the issue of political elites’ responsibility for choosing an adequate strategy and its implementation becomes particularly relevant. It is particularly useful to refer to the historical experience of the interwar period in such a situation, both successful and unsuccessful. The purpose of the study is to identify and characterize the position of the British political elite on the place and role of the Polish state in post–war Europe in 1919–1920. Materials and Methods. The research is based on documentary (including archival) and narrative sources. We tried to proceed from the basic principles of objectivity and historicism. In the course of the work, special historical research methods were used: historical-genetic, historical-comparative and historical-systemic. Results and Discussion. It is revealed that, participating in the restoration of the Polish state, the British political elite pursued its own strategic and tactical objectives, which determined its vision of this state. title: Transformation of peasant migrations: from otkhodnichestvo to organized recruitment
abstract: Importance. In the 1920s–1930s, the USSR underwent a radical transformation of the labor market regulation system: from the liberal mechanisms of free hiring during the New Economic Policy (NEP) to strict centralized control over the movement and use of labor. Under these conditions, the passportization campaign launched in the country in 1932 became a “filter,” granting the right to reside in cities only to those who could confirm their involvement in “socially useful labor” and were deemed necessary for industrialization. Materials and Methods. To confirm the scientific hypothesis that the evolution of state employment policy during this period represented a phased transition from spontaneous otkhodnichestvo (seasonal labor migration) to a system of organized recruitment (orgnabor) and the passport system, which, while aimed at mobilizing labor resources, were accompanied by institutional contradictions and a persistent labor shortage. Methods and methodology. The research is based on the analysis of normative legal acts (decrees of the Council of People’s Commissars, the Central Executive Committee, departmental instructions), statistical data, and records management materials,

title: Chatbots as a means of creating a psychologically comfortable environment for lexical and grammatical skills the formation of technical university students
abstract: Importance. In modern language teaching, there is a pressing need to find solutions to overcome psychological difficulties that students encounter when studying a foreign language, especially when dealing with complex lexico-grammatical material lacking, such as English phrasal verbs. Traditional approaches to training vocabulary, especially under limited classroom hours, tend to increase emotional stress in students, which negatively impacts their communicative activity. The aim of this study is to substantiate the feasibility of using generative-AI chatbots to minimize emotional barriers and create a psychologically comfortable environment for developing lexical and grammatical skills in engineering university students. Research Methods. The results of experimental training of 48 1st-year students of the Bauman Moscow State Technical University are presented. The experiment included an experimental group and a control group (24 students each) and lasted for 2 semesters during 2024–2025 academic year. title: Needs analysis as a course design tool in the near-to-native environment of a technical university
abstract: Importance This study aims to investigate how near-to-native language environment, affects the selection of stakeholders for needs analysis in an English for Specific Purposes (ESP) course design at Innopolis University, a Russian IT institution where English is a medium of instruction. Unlike traditional immersive or non-immersive settings, this unique context blends natural and formal language exposure, influencing stakeholder selection for NA. The study hypothesizes that in such environments, core course instructors, rather than students or English teachers, should be the primary stakeholders, as they directly benefit from students’ enhanced English proficiency. Materials and Methods. Through interviews and questionnaires with 39 faculty members and teaching assistants (TAs), the study identifies significant gaps in students’ speaking, writing, listening, and reading skills, particularly in academic and technical communication. Results and Discussion. Professors’ and TAs’ perspectives on the desired level of English laid foundation for designing an English course addressing the revealed issues. title: The state of correctional labor institutions in the USSR in 1923–1924 (using the Tambov Provincial House of Detention as an example)
abstract: Importance. A study of regional developments in the correctional labor system allows for a more detailed examination of the state’s ongoing efforts in this area. Identifying the positive and negative aspects of the system’s implementation at the local level allows for a more detailed assessment of the effectiveness of the prisoner rehabilitation policy. The purpose of this study is to examine the correctional labor system in the post-war period using the example of Tambov province. Materials and Methods. The research is based on materials discovered in the collections of the State Archives of the Tambov Region, including reports from the head of the Tambov Provincial House of Detention on prisoner movement, supplies, and the organization of correctional labor policies, as well as materials from commissions examining the state of prisons. The methodological basis of the work is a historical-systematic approach, comparative historical methods, and statistical methods. Results and Discussion. title: The method of axiological-anthropological reconstruction as a tool for operationalizing spiritual and moral values in supplementary education
abstract: Importance of this study stems from the fundamental contradiction between the declaration of spiritual and moral values as the basis of education and the lack of a methodological tool for their pedagogical operationalization, as well as a deficit of operational means for diagnosing their internalization, especially in the context of additional education. There is a shortage of methodological studies that provide a substantive, holistic transition from category analysis to the design of diagnostic practices. The aim of this study is to theoretically substantiate and develop a conceptual model for the operationalization of spiritual and moral values for supplementary education based on the author's method of axiological-anthropological reconstruction. Materials and Methods . The study is theoretical and methodological in nature. The primary material is a corpus of philosophical, pedagogical, and psychological sources and regulatory documents related to the category of DNC and the specifics of DO. title: Development of students’ foreign language written interaction and mediation skills based on practice with chatbots: results of the diagnostic stage
abstract: Importance . In the context of the digital transformation of education, integration processes are taking place aimed at the development and implementation of artificial intelligence tools in the practice of foreign language teaching. Modern chatbots that operate on the basis of large language models (ChatGPT, Gemini, GigaChat, etc.) have a unique didactic potential. They are able to simulate natural dialogical communication, adapt to the level of the interlocutor's language, generate communicative situations and provide instant feedback. Due to the didactic properties and methodological functions of chatbots, new perspectives are opening up for teaching productive types of speech activity, in particular writing, which is becoming increasingly important in the modern digital world. However, despite the generally recognized didactic potential of chatbots in teaching a foreign language, their use in practice is fragmented and is used to solve discrete learning tasks. At the same time, such types of communication activities as foreign language written interaction and mediation remain outside the focus of purposeful development. title: The potential of digital gamification in teaching English grammar to secondary school students
abstract: Importance . In the context of modern education, digital gamification is becoming an important tool for teaching any subject to different age groups. The use of gaming technologies and methods has always been relevant in school education, but the application of digital technologies in modern realities allows achieving better learning outcomes and increasing student motivation and engagement. The purpose of this work is to assess the effectiveness of using digital gamification elements, the Quizizz platform as an example, in teaching English grammar to secondary school students. Materials Methods . Theoretical, empirical, mathematical, and statistical research methods were used in the work. 33 sixth-grade students of Secondary School No. 35 in Vladivostok took part in the experimental work on teaching English grammar using the Quizizz resource: the control group consisted of 16 students (N = 16), and the experimental group consisted of 17 students (N = 17). Results and Discussion . title: Participation of the self-governing administration of the district towns of the Yaroslavl province in the fight against epidemics (1870–1914)
abstract: Importance . The sphere of public health and medicine is a significant area of public and state work. It is important to study the experience of the activities in this area of the city self-government bodies of the Russian Empire, which were renewed in 1870. In addition, the stated topic has acquired an active connection with modernity after the COVID-19 epidemic that began in 2019. The purpose of this study is to identify the main measures taken by the city authorities of the Yaroslavl province to combat epidemics in 1870–1914. Materials and Methods . The study is based on the analysis of a large number of historical sources, including unpublished sources, many of which are being introduced into scientific circulation for the first time. The methodological framework of this study is based on the fundamental principles of historical research. The study employs various general scientific and specific historical methods. Results and Discussion . title: Innovative pedagogical models: from theoretical foundations to creation technologies
abstract: Importance. The results of the author’s interpretation of the phenomenon of pedagogical modeling through the prism of modern trends in ensuring the innovativeness of the educational process are presented. Against the background of the current triumph of digital technologies, innovation is gaining the status of a key attribute of economic, social and cultural reality. It is becoming obvious that the technologies that will accompany educational systems will radically change in the coming years. All this will affect the process of pedagogical modeling – predictors and regulations for the creation of innovative pedagogical models will be transformed. The purpose of the study is to determine the objective prerequisites for the creation, distinctive characteristics, and mechanisms for constructing innovative pedagogical models. Materials and Methods. The subject of the research is an innovative pedagogical model as a system of reproduction of pedagogical reality in an abstract (simplified) form, including the structure, properties and relationships of its components. journal_name: Вестник Тамбовского университета. Серия: Гуманитарные науки
title: Translator and interpreter trainer competencies: expectations of students, educators and professionals
abstract: Importance . The importance of the study is determined by the growing needs of the modern labor market for highly qualified translator specialists who possess not only profound linguistic knowledge but also a wide range of professional competencies, including expert proficiency in modern computer-assisted translation tools based on artificial intelligence. Contemporary realities necessitate the training of interpreting and translation trainers who meet both student expectations and industry requirements. Therefore, it is expedient to identify the key competencies essential for modern interpreting and translation trainers to ensure high-quality educational processes and to prepare graduates capable of effectively solving professional tasks in a dynamically changing world. Materials and Methods . The study is based on the results of a survey of the main stakeholders in the educational process of interpreter and translator training: students, interpreting and translation trainers, and heads of companies providing linguistic services. title: Horizons for the development of foreign language education theory and practice in the collective monograph “The Metauniverse of Foreign Language Education: Bringing the Future Closer”, edited by O.A. Obdalova, O.V. Nagel, and L.G. Medvedeva
abstract: This article presents an analysis of the collective monograph “The Metauniverse of Foreign Language Education: Bringing the Future Closer”, edited by O.A. Obdalova, O.V. Nagel, and L.G. Medvedeva (Tomsk, 2025). This monograph is the result of the collaborative work of a team of researchers from Tomsk State University, specialists in pedagogy, linguistics, foreign language teaching theory and methodology, and practicing teachers. The authors focus on a wide range of contemporary issues in foreign language education. This two-section monograph combines an indepth theoretical analysis of the subject area with practical recommendations, case studies, and the results of implementing new methodological solutions.

journal_name: Вестник Тамбовского университета. Серия: Гуманитарные науки
title: From the Soviet legacy to market relations: the evolution of vocational and technical education in Central Asia (1991–2025)
abstract: Importance. Central Asia is one of the key regions for the joint development of the Belt and Road Initiative. Their vocational and technical education (VTЕ) systems took shape under the influence of the Soviet legacy and underwent national reforms after gaining independence to adapt to local socio-economic needs. Against the backdrop of advancing the Initiative jointly and implementing the outcomes of the China-Central Asia Summit, an in-depth study of VTE in this region holds important theoretical and practical significance for mutually beneficial bilateral cooperation. Materials and Methods. Theoretical methods are adopted, including analysis of academic literature related to the research theme and issues, as well as comparison, juxtaposition and generalization methods. A systematic approach and a historical-genetic approach are also applied. This study examines the current development status, characteristics and pressing challenges of VTE in Central Asia. Results and Discussion. Since gaining independence, the countries in the region have aligned their VTE systems with international standards, improved their regulatory and legal frameworks, and expanded international cooperation

title: Course design contests as a tool to enhance professional skills of future civil engineers
abstract: Importance. The modern construction industry places high demands on engineering university graduates for immediate integration into production processes. However, traditional forms of education often fail to account for the dynamics of the materials and technology markets, creating a gap between academic understanding and actual practice. Therefore, the search for and validation of new pedagogical technologies, such as course design contests, capable of effectively integrating industrial demands into the educational environment, has become urgent. The purpose of the research is to study formation mechanisms of graduates’ professional readiness to work in the construction industry using the example of competitive design. Research Methods. The study is based on an analysis of the experience of the Moscow State University of Civil Engineering (MGSU) in the implementation of industry-specific course design competitions, held jointly with leading manufacturer-employers. journal_name: Вестник Тамбовского университета. Серия: Гуманитарные науки
title: Overcoming linguacultural interference in EMI-CLIL education: a cognitive-discursive approach in a multicultural classroom (Russian and Chinese students)
abstract: Importance . The growth of English-medium instruction programs and the increasing number of international students, particularly from China, in Russian universities make the problem of over-coming linguacultural interference in teaching subject-specific disciplines in English highly relevant. The traditional instrumental teaching model does not account for the cognitive and cultural barriers that students face in a multicultural classroom. This study proposes the integration of content and language integrated learning with English-medium instruction, which overcomes the limitations of each approach individually. The purpose of this study is to substantiate an integrative model based on a cognitive‑discursive approach and to prove its effectiveness for fostering a secondary linguistic personality in Russian and Chinese students. Materials and Methods. The study employs a set of complementary methods: pedagogical observation (2023–2026) with detailed recording of classroom interactions, written surveys and interviews with students (92 participants, including 45 Chinese students and 47 master's students), as well as interviews with 17 instructors. journal_name: Вестник Тамбовского университета. Серия: Гуманитарные науки
title: Justification of the didactic status of the competitive approach to education
abstract: Importance. Pedagogical practice has accumulated substantial empirical evidence on the effectiveness of competitive forms of learning organisation: meta-analyses consistently report a moderate yet statistically significant positive effect on cognitive outcomes and academic engagement. Nevertheless, the categorical status of competitiveness within didactics remains ambiguous – different researchers describe it as a principle, a method, or a technology, which impedes theoretical synthesis and the comparability of research findings. Resolving this categorical ambiguity constitutes an independent theoretical problem. Materials and Methods. The study is conducted as a conceptual paper of the Theory Adaptation type: the construct of competitiveness, developed within motivational psychology and competition theory, is transferred into the categorical system of didactics with the necessary theoretical adaptation. The primary method is criterial differentiation of levels of didactic generalisation (approach, principle, method, technology), complemented by typological comparison of related didactic constructs. journal_name: Вестник Тамбовского университета. Серия: Гуманитарные науки
title: Peculiarities of aspectual relations in the lexical minimum of the first certification level: linguo-methodological analysis
abstract: Importance. Despite the availability of a large amount of educational materials on verb types, the topic cannot be considered sufficiently developed in its applied aspects. One problem is the broad interpretation of aspectual pairs, which allows for the combination of lexemes that go beyond the academic understanding of aspectual relations, leading to a distorted understanding of the essence of aspectual opposition. Furthermore, the organization of educational materials fails to consider the method of forming aspectual correlates – prefixal or suffixal. Objective: to analyze verbal lexemes included in the minimum vocabulary for Russian as a foreign language at the first certification level (A-2) from these perspectives and provide recommendations for their study in foreign audiences. Materials and Methods. Paired correlations are selected using the continuous sampling method. Maslov’s criteria are used to establish aspectual relations. Correlations are placed in two diagnostic contexts. In the next stage, word-formation analysis is used. The use of the field method allowed us to arrange correlations at various levels of the aspectual hierarchy – from pure pairs to modes of verb act

journal_name: Вестник Тамбовского университета. Серия: Гуманитарные науки
title: Analytical review of adaptive physical training of military personnel
abstract: Importance. Adaptive physical education of military personnel is currently of great interest. It is associated with the study of its content, the use of methods of adaptive physical training, rehabilitation, recreation and adaptive sports, the choice of means of adaptive physical education, dosage of physical activity, etc. The increase in interest in adaptive physical culture is also caused by a special military operation, an increase in the contingent in need of its means and methods. At the same time, the information array associated with ensuring the scientific content of the necessary material is represented by non-systemic studies in various areas of adaptive physical culture of military personnel. In this regard, the process of systematization and generalization of the results of research of domestic scientists in the field of adaptive physical culture of military personnel is very relevant and timely. The purpose of the study is to systematize and generalize the empirical results of research by domestic scientists in the field of adaptive physical culture of military personnel. journal_name: Вестник Тамбовского университета. Серия: Гуманитарные науки
title: Children’s homes of Yaroslavl region during the Great Patriotic War
abstract: Importance. The history of children’s homes during the Great Patriotic War remains insufficiently studied at the regional level. Most existing works rely on normative acts and do not reflect the practice of their implementation on the ground. The aim of the study is to trace the children’s home network development in Yaroslavl region in 1941–1945, to identify the problems caused by a sharp increase in caseload, and to determine the mechanisms used to overcome them. Materials and Methods. The study is based on documents from the State Archive of Yaroslavl Region and the Center for Documentation of Contemporary History of Yaroslavl Region, as well as published normative acts at the union and republican levels. The institutional approach and the comparative-historical method were applied. Results and Discussion. In 1941–1942, the system operated in crisis-response mode: the number of institutions grew from 25 to 425, while management was complicated by resident turnover, inter-departmental fragmentation, and resource shortages. journal_name: Вестник Тамбовского университета. Серия: Гуманитарные науки
title: An algorithm for teaching students intercultural communication through culturally marked elements (experimental testing)
abstract: Importance. The problem of insufficient intercultural literacy among students at non-linguistic universities, which subsequently leads to communication breakdowns in international professional projects due to a lack of understanding of English-language culturally marked elements (CMEs), such as proverbs, is examined. This relevance stems from globalization, which requires engineers not only to master terminology but also to decode hidden value codes. Materials and Methods. The study focused on the acquisition of CMEs by engineering students at Tambov State Technical University. In the presented experiment, the experimental group was taught according to the developed algorithm, while the control group conducted standard classes. The teaching methods included a test on 20 culturally marked elements with different levels of perception, role-playing simulations, and a reflective essay. Results and Discussion. In the course of working with engineering students, the experimental group demonstrated significant progress after 12 lessons: the average score increased from 0.8 (±SD) to 2.5 (±SD). journal_name: Вестник Тамбовского университета. Серия: Гуманитарные науки
title: Empirical testing of the effectiveness and validity of the author’s exercise complexes for military personnel with lower extremity amputations
abstract: Importance. The relevance of the study is determined by the need for standardized methods to assess physical readiness in service members with combat-related injuries, taking into account the specific features of the cardiorespiratory system and vestibular stability. The aim of the work was to evaluate the reliability, construct validity, and practical effectiveness of the author-developed exercise complexes (standard: 1, 10; adapted: 2–9) for monitoring physical fitness in this population. Materials and Methods. The study involved service members with lower limb amputations ( n = 15). The methods included performing exercises with recording of performance indicators (time, number of repetitions), functional tests (cardiorespiratory reserve 65–70 %, vestibular stability 10–15 points), as well as correlation and consistency analyses (ICC, Spearman’s correlation coefficient) using Statistica 27.0 software at a significance level of p Results and Discussion. The results demonstrate high within-class reliability of the complexes (ICC = 0.58–0.93 for subgroups 4–6, 8–9, 2–5, 1–10) and strong correlations between exercise indicators (4–6 with 8: r = 0.83; 4–9: r = −0.71; 6–9: r = −0.76)

journal_name: Вестник Тамбовского университета. Серия: Гуманитарные науки
title: The worldview of conservative liberals and legalists in the works of Russian scientists at the turn of the 20th–21st centuries
abstract: Importance. The historiography of the legalists’ worldview is considered based on their scientific works and practical activities. The purpose of the study is to identify a set of ideas that developed within the liberal jurisprudence of the Russian Empire on the basis of extensive historical and philosophical literature, to determine the main points of view of modern scientists on the nature of conservative liberalism. Materials and Methods. A significant part of the works of leading legalists have been published. This facilitates the researcher’s tasks. The involvement of many sources (countless articles and monographs of legalists) coupled with modern research allows us to compare different points of view on the essence of the movement and come to common conclusions. The use of the problemchronological method and the comparison method make it possible to conduct this analysis. Results and Discussion. Legalists are understood as an association of liberal dignitaries of the Russian Empire, mainly those from the judicial corps, and legal scholars. journal_name: Вестник Тамбовского университета. Серия: Гуманитарные науки
title: From the May Fourth Movement to the Comintern: the making of a Chinese revolutionary through the example of Xiao San
abstract: Importance. The biography of Xiao San (1896–1983) represents a typical path of a Chinese revolutionary intellectual, illustrating the transformation from a May Fourth Movement patriot to a professional communist integrated into the international communist movement. His transnational experience is crucial for understanding the formation of sinified Marxism and the CCP’s culturalideological policy. Objective – to reconstruct Xiao San’s biographical trajectory as a model revolutionary career and assess his contribution to party propaganda and revolutionary literature. Materials and Methods. The study employs archival materials from The Russian State Archive of Socio-Political History (Comintern fonds), memoirs, Chinese and Soviet sources. The biographical method, historical hermeneutics, and critical source analysis are applied. Results and Discussion. It is established that Xiao San passed through key revolutionary stages: participation in the May Fourth Movement, political organizing in Europe, studies at the Communist University of the Toilers of the East, and activities in the USSR. title: Methodological model of professionally oriented foreign language teaching for students in specialized classes based on technological solutions based on artificial intelligence
abstract: Importance. Artificial intelligence technologies are being actively introduced into school education, requiring a revision of the content, methods and means of teaching a foreign language. At the same time, professionally oriented education in specialized classes based on technological solutions based on artificial intelligence, which contributes to the formation of professional selfdetermination of schoolchildren, is of particular importance. At the same time, the existing teaching methods do not sufficiently take into account the didactic potential of artificial intelligence for the integration of language and vocational training for the purpose of vocational guidance of schoolchildren. The purpose of the research is to develop and describe a methodological model of professionally oriented teaching of a foreign language to students of specialized classes based on technological solutions based on artificial intelligence within the framework of the integrated course “Foreign Language and Computer Science”. title: Bilingual interference in corporate adult education: discursive and methodological aspect
abstract: Importance. Bilingual interference affects the effectiveness of business communication and the formation of a specialist’s communicative behavior. In the methodology of adult education in a corporate environment, its discursive aspect remains insufficiently studied. The aim of the study is to theoretically conceptualize bilingual interference as a cognitive-discursive phenomenon and to experimentally test the effectiveness of a methodology for its conscious management. Research Methods. The methodological framework is based on the principles of cross-linguistic interaction theory, the concept of bilingual interference, and discursive and communicativeactivity approaches. The empirical part is implemented in the form of a pedagogical experiment involving 120 learners. Results and Discussion. Interference manifestations are systemic in nature. Pragmatic (51 %) and discursive (47 %) interference demonstrated the highest frequency. The results of the control stage showed statistically significant dynamics: lexical interference decreased from 42 to 25 %, grammatical from 38 to 24 %, pragmatic from 51 to 28 %, and discursive from 47 to 26 %. title: Pro-Russian sentiments of the Far Eastern White emigration in the 1920s–1930s
abstract: Importance. The tragedy of the schism in Russian society in 1917 continues to evoke controversy among researchers in the 20th and 21st centuries. One of the reasons for the heated debate is the lack of archival documents, or the presence of them, which provide a one-sided portrayal of the participants in the schism. Therefore, for many decades, evaluative judgments about the White émigrés were opportunistic, with conclusions drawn according to politically determined patterns, and the class-based approach prevented us from seeing specific individuals in specific situations. The aim of this study is to identify the social and living conditions of the White émigrés in the Far East and their attitudes toward Soviet power and Russia as a whole. Materials and Methods. The study is based on archival data from the Central Archives of the Foreign Intelligence Service of the Russian Federation, the Russian State Military Archive, and the State Archives of the Russian Federation. The primary method used in the study was an anthropological approach, focusing on the individual. However, the formational approach has not lost its significance. title: The Stavropol Cossacks in the Gurian detachment’s actions
abstract: Importance. The research the participation of representatives of the Kuban linear Cossacks, using the example of the 4th Stavropol Brigade of the Caucasian linear Cossack army, in the events of the Crimean War that took place in Western Georgia in 1855. Based on published and unpublished sources, the article examines the actions of the linear Cossacks as part of the Guria detachment and their contribution to the defense of the region, which was under attack by the superior forces of the Ottomans. For the first time, the research provides data on the specific participation of the Stavropol Cossacks, their losses, and the awards they received during this campaign. The purpose of this work is to supplement the regimental historiography of the Kuban Line Cossacks, which has not been studied to this day. Materials and Methods. The paper is based on both classical works on the Crimean (Eastern) War and documents from federal and regional archives that have been introduced into scientific circulation for the first time. title: Methodological substantiation of formation process and civic identity development among university students in the context of digital transformation of education
abstract: Importance. This publication prepared within the context of academic discussions concerning the specific features of the formation and strengthening of an individual's civic identity amidst ongoing social and educational transformations. The study aims at developing and conceptualizing the methodological foundations for the formation and development of civic identity among university students in the context of the digital transformation of education. Materials and Methods. The realization of aim was achieved through the application of dialectical, systemic, and theoretical approaches. Methods employed include structural-logical and epistemological analysis, the study and synthesis of pedagogical experience, abstraction, and theoretical modeling. The research is based on contemporary theoretical developments and empirical data characterizing both domestic and international experience in civic education and personal development. Results and Discussion. title: Creating an operational framework in educational institutions as an indicator of the quality of foreign language proficiency
abstract: Importance. The purpose of the study is to identify the means of improving the quality of foreign language education through such a didactic tool as the creation of an operational basis for language and speech skills in the language. Purposeful and systematic work on linguistic aspects of the language can be an important tool in improving the methodology of teaching a non-native language. This presupposes, first of all, the correct and methodically justified formation of an operational basis for the functioning of speech activities. The operational framework presupposes rational and purposeful teaching of aspects of the language being studied (aspects of foreign language speech) in the form of phonetic, grammatical and lexical skills. This includes the process of developing spelling skills and reading techniques in the language being studied. The process of formation and conscious management of operations included in the structure of these types of skills can be considered as a tool for creating operational foundations. title: Improving the content of primary training for children with autism spectrum disorders in athletics
abstract: Importance. Practice requests indicate the need to teach children with autism spectrum disorder complex-coordinated motor actions in athletics disciplines, starting from the initial training stage. The problem is caused by an irrational distribution of time for sports training and the lack of teaching methods and guidelines for forming a rational structure of motor actions. The purpose of the study is to theoretically substantiate the need to redistribute time for sports training and develop a methodology for teaching complex-coordinated motor actions to children with autism spectrum disorder at the initial training stage in athletics. Materials and Methods. Based on the analysis of scientific and methodological literature and the results of a questionnaire survey of specialists on the problem of teaching complexcoordinated motor actions to children with ASD, an analysis is conducted of the ratio of types of sports training recommended by the Federal Standard of Sports Training for the Sport of “Sports for Persons with Intellectual Disabilities” (PID) for track and field disciplines at the initial training stage. title: Intercultural communicative competence as a guiding principle for adult foreign language education in a polycentric world
abstract: Importance. Against the backdrop of the emergence of the polycentric system of international relations, as well as shifting values and objectives of foreign language education, there is a need to review approaches of teaching foreign languages to adults. The purpose of this research is to provide a theoretical foundation for intercultural communicative competence that addresses the objectives of proactively promoting native country’s discourse in cross-cultural interaction. Research Methods. The following methods were employed in the course of the study: a review of the theoretical literature on the research topic; a critical analysis of contemporary academic research in the field of intercultural foreign language education; the synthesis and classification of information; conceptual and terminological differentiation; and a method for modelling the components of intercultural competence. Results and Discussion. title: Teaching students dialogic speech through communication with chatbots based on artificial intelligence
abstract: Importance. Dynamically developing artificial intelligence technologies and the emergence of a large number of neural network tools reinforce the need to create new methods of teaching foreign languages in the process of studying special disciplines. Despite a significant amount of work devoted to the use of artificial intelligence tools in teaching foreign languages to students, only some scientists have considered the possibility of integrating neural networks into teaching foreignlanguage dialogic speech. The purpose of the research is to develop a methodology for teaching students in non-linguistic areas of written dialogic speech through communication with AI-based chatbots. Materials and Methods. title: Formation of the legal culture of public order enforcement officers in Russia in the first third of the 20th century (based on the Chernozem center of Russia)
abstract: Importance. The issues of legal consciousness and legal culture development are relevant for modern society and for individuals who are employed in the public service system of law enforcement agencies. The purpose of this study is to analyze not only the acquisition of professional skills by employees of public order agencies in the first third of the last century, but also to identify and compare the methods of forming their legal culture, which includes cognitive, emotionalpsychological, and behavioral elements. Materials and Methods. The research is based on a wide range of sources, including archival documents from seven central and local archives, as well as legal acts and scientific works from that time. The study, which is interdisciplinary in nature, uses the following methods: the universal (dialectical) method; formal-logical methods; general scientific methods used in humanities field; special methods in history (problem-chronological, historical-comparative, historical-typological, historical description, etc.); and methods from other sciences. title: Structure and purchasing power of population incomes in the USSR and Russia in the 1980s–1990s: a comparative analysis
abstract: Importance. The study of the dynamics and structure of income of the population in the crucial 1980s and 1990s remains of high scientific and practical importance. This period, encompassing the late Soviet stagnation, perestroika and radical market reforms, is a unique example of the transformation of the socio-economic system in a short period of time. The analysis of the causes and consequences of income changes makes it possible to identify the underlying mechanisms of economic crises, inflation, rising inequality and poverty, which is important for understanding modern socio-economic processes in Russia. The aim of the study is to conduct a comparative analysis of the income structure and their purchasing power in the USSR (in the 1980s – early 1990s) and Russia (in the 1990s), as well as to identify government policy impact on the well-being of the population in these periods. Materials and Methods. The study is based on the analysis of data from the official statistics of the USSR State Statistics Committee and Rosstat, materials from household budget surveys, and the works of economists and historians. title: Teaching agricultural university students professional foreign language communication based on practice with technological solutions based on artificial intelligence
abstract: Importance. The digital transformation of higher education in general, as well as the active integration of artificial intelligence (AI) technologies into foreign language teaching in particular, open up new opportunities for the development of students’ speaking skill, While the use of AI for the development of oral foreign language speaking skills has already been studied on the basis of experiments conducted in linguistic universities, the potential of using chatbots and web applications for the information of professionally oriented dialogic speech of students in non-linguistic universities (especially agricultural ones) remains insufficiently researched to date, which determines the relevance of this work. The aim of the study is to develop a methodology for developing professionally oriented foreign language dialogic speech skills of students in a non-linguistic university based on speaking practice with artificial intelligence tools.
